clauses.text: The Company shall pay for Medical Expenses incurred towards Hospitalisation of the Insured Person, following a Medically Necessary Treatment, provided the period of Hospitalisation exceeds 24 consecutive hours, up to the Sum Insured under the Policy Schedule.

Room rent, boarding and nursing expenses shall be restricted to 1.5% of the Sum Insured per day, subject to a maximum of Rs. 6,000 per day. If the Insured Person opts for a higher category room, all associated expenses shall be paid in proportion to the entitled room rent.
Cataract treatment, including phaco-emulsification and lens implantation, is payable up to a maximum of Rs. 30,000 per eye or 15% of the Sum Insured, whichever is lower, per Policy Year.

No claim shall be payable in respect of any illness contracted by the Insured Person during the first 30 days from the Policy commencement date, except claims arising from an Accident which is otherwise covered under this Policy.

A waiting period of 24 months of continuous coverage shall apply to the following conditions before any related claim becomes admissible: Hernia, Cataract, Hydrocele, Sinusitis and related surgeries, Hysterectomy for menorrhagia or fibromyoma, and Knee/Hip Joint Replacement not necessitated by Accident.

Maternity related expenses, including normal and caesarean delivery, shall be admissible only after the Insured Person completes 30 months of continuous Policy coverage with the Company, and shall be subject to the maternity sub-limits specified in the Policy Schedule.

Expenses relating to the treatment of a Pre-Existing Disease and its direct complications shall be excluded from the scope of cover until 36 months of continuous coverage have elapsed since inception of the first Policy with the Company.

Treatment relating to dental care, dentures or orthodontics, and any Cosmetic or plastic surgery undertaken to preserve or enhance appearance, are excluded unless necessitated by an Accident occurring during the Policy Period and requiring Hospitalisation.
Expenses incurred for transporting the Insured Person by road ambulance to the nearest Hospital equipped to provide the necessary treatment shall be reimbursed up to Rs. 2,500 per Hospitalisation.

Medical Expenses incurred during the 30 days immediately before the date of admission for the same illness or injury for which the Hospitalisation claim is admissible shall be covered as Pre-Hospitalisation expenses.

Medical Expenses incurred during the 60 days immediately after discharge from Hospital for the same illness or injury for which the Hospitalisation claim is admissible shall be covered as Post-Hospitalisation expenses.
A Co-payment of 15% shall be borne by the Insured Person on every admissible claim where treatment is availed at a Hospital that is not part of the Company's Preferred Provider Network.
